$description: Evernote public signed-out surfaces, measured 2026-11-22 from computed styles on https://evernote.com/, https://evernote.com/en-us/compare-plans, https://evernote.com/en-us/features/ai-features, and the empty login wall at https://accounts.evernote.com/login. The homepage and plans page paint the light set. The AI Features page puts class dark on header and main and paints the dark set. There is no theme switch. prefers-color-scheme was dark in the measurement browser and the homepage stayed light.

$extensions.source: Computed backgroundColor of header on https://evernote.com/ is rgb(249, 246, 242). :root --color-bg-primary is #F9F6F2.
Computed backgroundColor of the homepage hero card is rgb(244, 238, 229). :root --color-bg-secondary is #F4EEE5.

ink.$description: Primary ink for type and the filled button.

$extensions.source: Computed color of homepage h1 is rgb(20, 20, 20). Start for free backgroundColor is the same rgb(20, 20, 20). :root --color-text-primary is #141414.

ink-soft.$description: Secondary ink and the dark marketing band.

$extensions.source: Computed color of the homepage hero paragraph is rgb(38, 38, 38). :root --color-text-secondary is #262626. The homepage dark band backgroundColor is the same rgb(38, 38, 38).
Computed color of the plans page 'Pay $79.90 / year' is rgb(78, 77, 76). Class text-text-tertiary. :root --color-text-tertiary is #4E4D4C.

white.$description: White label on the ink button, and the login wall field.

$extensions.source: Computed color of the Start for free label span on https://evernote.com/ is rgb(255, 255, 255). Login wall body backgroundColor is rgb(255, 255, 255).

green.$description: Evernote green. Declared as the hover fill. Not sampled from a hovered button.

$extensions.source: Stylesheet rule .bg-green and .text-green set rgb(0, 168, 45). The favicon SVG path fill is #00A82D. An AI Features SVG computed color is rgb(0, 168, 45). The button hover rule .hover:bg-green:hover was not hovered.

lime.$description: Lime secondary green, painted on chips and on the dark-page primary button.

$extensions.source: Computed backgroundColor of the homepage Capture chip and Discover more button is rgb(148, 225, 48). Class bg-green-secondary. On the AI Features page, Start for free backgroundColor is the same rgb(148, 225, 48).

stroke-button.$description: Outline of the secondary plan button.

$extensions.source: Computed borderTopColor of Choose Starter on https://evernote.com/en-us/compare-plans is rgb(161, 161, 161). :root --color-stroke-buttons is #A1A1A1.
Computed borderTopColor of the homepage hero card is rgb(231, 231, 231). :root --color-stroke-cards is #E7E7E7.
